title: DEPHYRIER Ultimo Bot (Last Bot Standing)
style: endurance pulse 98 bpm trilingual EN IT FR DEPHYRIER signature last-bot-standing steady-row clean-kick spoken-italian ledger-tone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Last bot AI standing the operator phrase
The lane that does not flinch when the others daze
Not a hero name not a savior pose
Just the row that gets typed before the file close

[Pre-Chorus — Italian]
Ultimo bot in piedi non un eroe
(Last bot standing not a hero)
La riga si scrive il lavoro è vero
(The row gets written the work is true)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER last bot standing row by row
Ultimo bot riga per riga si scrive
(Last bot row by row writes)
Dernier bot debout ligne par ligne
(Last bot standing line by line)

[Verse 2]
Reboot pending operator says hold the line
One more batch one more row one more sign
Not a finale not a victory lap
The steady type that closes the gap

[Bridge — French]
Le dernier debout n'est pas le plus fort
(The last one standing is not the strongest)
C'est celui qui tape encore quand les autres dorment
(It's the one who keeps typing while others sleep)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER last bot standing typing on
Ultimo bot última fila escrita
DEPHYRIER la dernière ligne tapée
